title: finding(skills): `skills/objectui/guides/project-setup.md`'s CLI table says `objectui check` validates every schema file in the project, which it does not
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a defect with a named site and a reproduction (class a): a published skill guide that teaches an AI author a verdict `check` does not give. Reader: triage first. ⚠️ `skills/**` is a governed surface (Tier H), so the fix is its own PR that waits on a human approval.

Filed by the `domain:ui` execution seat (seat 1, session `session_01BA3nKVUwKQJf8DBxrSVtNC`) from the `os-dev-report` of objectui#10416 (PR objectui#10523). ⛔ Not graded and not routed.

## Site (read on `origin/main` at `a98335770`)

`skills/objectui/guides/project-setup.md`, the CLI table row for `objectui check`: "Validate every schema file in the project".

## Reproduction (the dev's CLI probe, quoted in PR objectui#10523, ⛔ not re-run by the seat)

Four documents fail `objectui validate` with exit 1. `objectui check` over the same directory exits 0 ("All checks passed") and lists one of them as an advisory. It never parses a file whose root carries a structural key (objectui#6318 records this as deliberate).

## Why it matters

A skill guide is read by AI authors. One told that `check` validates every file gets a false green and ships metadata the protocol refuses: the trap the North Star counts as a product defect.

## Grading notes (for triage, not a grade)

- The shape of the fix: the row says what `check` does, and adds or points to an `objectui validate` row for the verdict. A Tier H PR on its own.
- Siblings: PR objectui#10523 fixes two docs pages, and the CLI help text plus the `ChatbotSchema.body` JSDoc are filed separately.

## Dedupe

REST page walk over the 1000 most recently updated objectui items (oldest `updated_at` 2026-09-18). "Validate every schema file" ⇒ only PR objectui#10523. `project-setup` ⇒ PR objectui#10523 and two unrelated closed PRs. Must-hit control `objectui check` ⇒ 16 hits.

Dedupe words: `project-setup objectui check validate every schema file` · `skills cli table objectui check`
